name: sarkari-jobs-frontend-tools
description: Local and CI quality checks for the SarkariJobs+ static frontend

scripts.check: npm run check:css && npm run check:html && npm run check:js && npm run check:format
scripts.check:format: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --check README.md .prettierrc.json stylelint.config.json htmlvalidate.json lighthouserc.json playwright.config.js scripts/*.js tests/*.js
scripts.format: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --write README.md .prettierrc.json stylelint.config.json htmlvalidate.json lighthouserc.json playwright.config.js scripts/*.js tests/*.js
